title: SPOT assignment history (data model v2)
description: Who held one robot in one match, in order (DV-16). Saved behind the in-memory registry like the sessions, so the server can tell, when a record arrives, whether it came from the scouter who held the robot at the end of the match (RT-35) and whether that scouter joined late (RT-34).

until.description: When they stopped holding it: released, taken back, or finished. Null while they hold it.

ended.description: Why the scouter stopped holding the robot: an admin released it (RT-31), or it was taken back before they scouted (the match changed, they signed out or were removed). Null while they hold it, and for a scouter who finished the match, who stays its holder at the end.

afterStart.description: They got the robot after someone had started scouting the match, so their record covers only part of it (RT-34).
